documents.title: 3D Print Quality Troubleshooting Guide
documents.description: Visual, symptom-based guide to diagnosing and fixing common FDM print defects like stringing, warping, under-extrusion, and layer separation.

documents.title: 3D Printer Bed Leveling Guide
documents.description: Step-by-step guide to leveling a 3D printer's bed (manual and assisted/mesh leveling) to achieve consistent first-layer adhesion.

documents.title: 3D Printing Filament Comparison Chart
documents.description: Side-by-side comparison of common filament types (PLA, PETG, ABS, TPU, Nylon, and more) covering print temperature, bed temperature, and material properties.

documents.title: Heat-Set Threaded Insert Size Reference
documents.description: Hole-size and boss-diameter reference for heat-set threaded inserts (M2-M8) used to add durable metal threads to 3D printed parts.

documents.title: Metric Screw Thread Size Reference (M2-M18)
documents.description: Standard ISO metric screw/bolt thread dimensions (major/minor diameter, pitch, tap drill size) for common sizes like M2, M3, and M5 used in 3D printed enclosures and fasteners.

documents.title: Nozzle Size vs. Layer Height Guide
documents.description: Practical guidance from Prusa's knowledge base on choosing a layer height relative to nozzle diameter (max ~80% of nozzle size) for print quality and speed trade-offs.

documents.title: Arduino Language Reference
documents.description: Official Arduino API/language reference documenting every built-in function, structure, and variable type used when writing Arduino sketches.

documents.title: Arduino Mega 2560 Pinout Diagram
documents.description: Official Arduino documentation and full pinout diagram for the Mega 2560, useful for projects needing many I/O pins, multiple UARTs, or extra PWM/interrupt lines.

documents.title: Arduino Nano Pinout Diagram
documents.description: Official Arduino documentation and full pinout diagram for the compact Nano board, popular for breadboard and space-constrained projects.

documents.title: Arduino Uno R3 Pinout Diagram
documents.description: Official Arduino documentation and full pinout diagram for the Uno R3 board, showing digital/analog pins, power, and communication interfaces.

documents.title: 555 Timer IC Pinout & Circuit Reference
documents.description: Pin-by-pin reference for the classic 555 timer IC plus common astable, monostable, and bistable circuit configurations.

documents.title: AWG Wire Gauge Current Capacity Chart
documents.description: American Wire Gauge reference table listing conductor diameter, resistance, and safe maximum current (ampacity) for both chassis wiring and power transmission use.

documents.title: Adafruit's Guide to Excellent Soldering
documents.description: A thorough, well-regarded walkthrough of tools, technique, and troubleshooting for through-hole and basic SMD hand soldering.

documents.title: Battery Chemistry & Nominal Voltage Reference
documents.description: Comparison of common battery chemistries and formats (alkaline, NiMH/NiCd, LiPo, lithium coin cells, lead acid) with their nominal voltages and rechargeability.

documents.title: Breadboard Basics & Internal Wiring
documents.description: Explains how a solderless breadboard's internal metal strips connect rows and power rails, essential for understanding how components on a breadboard are actually wired together.

documents.title: Ceramic Capacitor Code Chart
documents.description: Reference table for decoding the 3-digit EIA capacitance codes printed on ceramic and film capacitors (e.g. "104" = 100nF/0.1uF) into pF, nF, and uF values.

documents.title: ESD Safety Reference for Handling Electronics
documents.description: Fundamentals of electrostatic discharge (ESD) and how it damages sensitive components, plus the grounding/handling practices used to prevent it, from the industry ESD standards body.

documents.title: I2C Device Address Reference
documents.description: Adafruit's comprehensive, community-maintained list of I2C bus addresses used by common sensors, displays, and breakout boards, useful for resolving address conflicts.

documents.title: Linear Voltage Regulator Pinout Reference (7805/LM317/AMS1117)
documents.description: Pinout and usage reference for the most common linear voltage regulators used in hobby electronics, covering the fixed-output 78xx family, the adjustable LM317, and the compact AMS1117 LDO.

documents.title: Ohm's Law / Power Law Wheel
documents.description: The classic circular cheat sheet showing all the algebraic relationships between voltage, current, resistance, and power for quick calculation.

documents.title: Resistor Color Code Chart
documents.description: Standard chart for decoding 4-band, 5-band, and 6-band resistor color codes into resistance value, tolerance, and temperature coefficient.

documents.title: SMD Passive Component Size Chart
documents.description: Reference chart of standard surface-mount package sizes (0201, 0402, 0603, 0805, 1206, 1210, etc.) with both imperial and metric dimensions for resistors and capacitors.

documents.title: Small Connector Ecosystem Guide (JST/Dupont/Qwiic/Grove)
documents.description: Overview and comparison of the small board-to-wire connector standards common in maker electronics, including JST-PH/XH, Dupont, STEMMA QT/Qwiic (JST-SH), and Grove.

documents.title: Raspberry Pi Computer Hardware Documentation
documents.description: Official Raspberry Pi Foundation documentation covering the 40-pin GPIO header, pin functions, and electrical characteristics for all Raspberry Pi computer models.

documents.title: Raspberry Pi GPIO Pinout (pinout.xyz)
documents.description: Interactive, clickable reference for every pin on the Raspberry Pi 40-pin (and 26-pin) GPIO header across all models, plus a huge database of HAT/pHAT add-on board pinouts.

documents.title: Raspberry Pi HAT+ Specification
documents.description: Official mechanical, electrical, and EEPROM specification for designing Raspberry Pi HAT+ (Hardware Attached on Top) add-on boards, the current standard superseding the original HAT spec.

documents.title: Raspberry Pi Models & Specs Comparison
documents.description: Official comparison tables covering every current Raspberry Pi product line (flagship SBCs, Zero, Compute Module, keyboard computers, and Pico) with SoC, memory, GPIO, and connectivity specs.
